notes:
Summary: Closed-lost. Customer selected AWS managed endpoints (SageMaker + Lambda serving) over Redwood Dedicated/Private. Primary reasons: procurement preference to consolidate onto existing AWS enterprise agreement, security team comfort with AWS-managed lifecycle (IAM + native KMS + logging), and lack of a committed internal champion to make a business case for third-party inference platform.

Timeline / activities:
- 2025-09-10: Initial inbound (signup) -> qualification call with Maya. Use-case: low-latency chat assistant + reranking of ad candidates. Interested in VPC + KMS + EU data residency for EU subsystems.
- 2025-10-02: DEEP DISCOVERY w/ Head of Platform (Julian Price) + Security (Anita Rao). Sent security questionnaire (drive/redwood/security/hydrus-sq-2025-10.pdf).
- 2025-11-15: POC kickoff. Deployed Redwood Dedicated trial cluster in us-east-1 (short-lived). Diego led integration for KV cache + batching tests.
- 2025-12-08: Mid-POC benchmark: Redwood lower per-token cost in steady-state; latency SLOs met at 99th p50/p95. Noted extra ops hours for running dedicated infrastructure and patching.
- 2026-01-12: Procurement review. Hydrus legal & procurement favored consolidation on AWS to simplify contractual and billing flows.
- 2026-01-20: Final review w/ Head of Platform and CTO. CTO quote: "We need less vendor surface — stick to platform services we already own." Security: preferred native AWS audit trails and control plane.
- 2026-02-14: Final decision communicated: select AWS SageMaker endpoints + native IAM/KMS integration. Budget reallocated Q1.

POC findings / internal notes:
- Technical: Redwood met performance and cost targets in isolation; win on raw perf/cost for heavy batching.
- Non-technical dominant: procurement and enterprise cloud strategy trumped standalone TCO.
- No strong internal champion to run a cross-org procurement push for specialized inference platform. Platform lead sympathetic but lacked exec mandate.

Decision drivers (quotes & paraphrase):
- "Easier to stay in the ecosystem — billing, support, IAM." — Head of Platform (Julian).
- "Security wants a single source of truth for keys and audit logs." — Anita Rao, Security.

Next steps / playbook items:
- Mark as closed-lost; reason = lost_to_hyperscaler_managed_endpoints.
- Add to 6-month nurture cadence: share hybrid playbook content (routing, cost comparison vs managed), success stories where customers migrated back from hyperscaler endpoints.
- Keep drive docs and Fireflies transcript linked for reference.
- Opportunity re-open signals: change in procurement policy, new internal champion, or requirement for multi-cloud private deployment.
